excerpt: Helps engineering tools work together as one engineering system. - rivora-dev/rivora
content_html:
Rivora is an open-source workspace for understanding engineering systems.

It helps your existing tools like GitHub, CI, observability platforms, infrastructure, and coding agents work together through durable investigations, shared context, evidence-backed conclusions, and controlled execution.

Rivora does not replace your engineering tools. It helps them operate as one engineering system.

Install

curl -fsSL https://rivora.dev/install | sh

Then run:

rivora

This opens the Unified Workspace.

Use plain English to investigate your software, or press / to discover available actions.

rivora --help
rivora --version
rivora <command>

The installer supports macOS and Linux and installs both rivora and the compatibility rivora-workspace binary.

What you can do

With Rivora, you can:

  • create and explore engineering investigations
  • connect engineering systems through guided connector onboarding and secure credential storage
  • collect observations from local projects, GitHub, CI, Kubernetes, and Sentry
  • build durable engineering memory
  • evaluate evidence and verify conclusions
  • generate improvement proposals
  • review controlled execution plans
  • inspect receipts and measured outcomes
  • search prior investigations, patterns, and trends
  • hand structured work to coding agents without granting hidden authority

How it works

Workspace / CLI
      ↓
Capabilities
      ↓
Runtime
      ↓
Engineering Objects
      ↓
Local Store

The Runtime is the source of truth.

Conversation is an interface over typed engineering objects—not the persistence model and not an authority boundary.

Proposal acceptance never starts execution. External mutation requires an explicit Execution Plan, exact-revision approval, and centralized policy.

Quick start

Open the Workspace:

rivora

Try:

Investigate why the latest deployment failed.

Show me investigations related to Kubernetes.

Verify the strongest conclusion in this investigation.

Create an execution plan for the accepted proposal.

Press / to browse actions or Ctrl+P to open the global command palette.

For one-shot CLI workflows:

rivora investigation create "CI failure on main"
rivora observe --investigation <ID> --local .
rivora evaluate --investigation <ID>
rivora verify --investigation <ID>
rivora proposal generate --investigation <ID>

Connectors (connect before collect):

rivora connector connect github                  Authenticate GitHub (device login or PAT)
rivora connector status                          Detailed status for all connectors
rivora connector status github                   Status, storage label, next steps (no secrets)
rivora connector test github                     Verify credentials
rivora connector collect github --repository owner/repo   Preview observations from GitHub
rivora connector disconnect github               Remove Rivora-managed credentials
rivora connector                                 Intent-first summary of all connectors
rivora connector github                          Intent-first summary for a specific connector
rivora connector collect local                   Preview observations from a local project
rivora connector list                            List connectors (alias for overview)

Documentation

  • Workspace guide
  • Installation
  • Capability guide
  • Connector guide
  • Architecture and RFCs (RFC-000 … RFC-031)
  • RFC-029 Unified Workspace
  • RFC-030 Refined Workspace
  • RFC-031 Connector Onboarding
  • Roadmap
  • Changelog

Development

cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
cargo build --workspace --release

See .agents/skills/build-rivora/SKILL.md for Rivora’s engineering workflow.

Status

Rivora is under active development.

The current release is v0.12.0 — Guided Connector Onboarding (connect before collect; secure credential storage).

See the Connector guide, Workspace guide, and RFC-031.

License

Apache-2.0. See LICENSE.

content_html_zh:
Rivora 是一个用于理解工程系统的开源工作区。

它可以帮助您现有的工具（例如 GitHub、CI、可观察性平台、基础设施和编码代理）通过持久调查、共享上下文、有证据支持的结论和受控执行来协同工作。

Rivora 不会取代您的工程工具。 它帮助它们作为一个工程系统运行。

安装

curl -fsSL https://rivora.dev/install | sh

然后运行：

rivora

这将打开统一工作区。

使用简单的英语来调查您的软件，或按 / 来发现可用的操作。

rivora --help
rivora --version
rivora <command>

安装程序支持 macOS 和 Linux，并安装 rivora 和兼容性 rivora-workspace 二进制文件。

你能做什么

借助 Rivora，您可以：

  • 创建和探索工程调查
  • 通过引导连接器加入和安全凭证存储来连接工程系统
  • 从本地项目、GitHub、CI、Kubernetes 和 Sentry 收集观察结果
  • 建立持久的工程记忆
  • 评估证据并验证结论
  • 生成改进建议
  • 审查受控执行计划
  • 检查收据和测量结果
  • 搜索先前的调查、模式和趋势
  • 将结构化工作手工交给编码代理，而不授予隐藏权限

它是如何运作的

Workspace / CLI
      ↓
Capabilities
      ↓
Runtime
      ↓
Engineering Objects
      ↓
Local Store

运行时是真理的来源。

对话是类型化工程对象上的接口，而不是持久性模型，也不是权限边界。

提案接受永远不会开始执行。 外部突变需要明确的执行计划、精确的修订批准和集中策略。

快速启动

打开工作区：

rivora

Try:

Investigate why the latest deployment failed.

Show me investigations related to Kubernetes.

Verify the strongest conclusion in this investigation.

Create an execution plan for the accepted proposal.

按 / 浏览操作或按 Ctrl+P 打开全局命令面板。

对于一次性 CLI 工作流程：

rivora investigation create "CI failure on main"
rivora observe --investigation <ID> --local .
rivora evaluate --investigation <ID>
rivora verify --investigation <ID>
rivora proposal generate --investigation <ID>

连接器（收集前连接）：

rivora connector connect github                  Authenticate GitHub (device login or PAT)
rivora connector status                          Detailed status for all connectors
rivora connector status github                   Status, storage label, next steps (no secrets)
rivora connector test github                     Verify credentials
rivora connector collect github --repository owner/repo   Preview observations from GitHub
rivora connector disconnect github               Remove Rivora-managed credentials
rivora connector                                 Intent-first summary of all connectors
rivora connector github                          Intent-first summary for a specific connector
rivora connector collect local                   Preview observations from a local project
rivora connector list                            List connectors (alias for overview)

  • 路线图

发展

cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
cargo build --workspace --release

请参阅 .agents/skills/build-rivora/SKILL.md 了解 Rivora 的工程工作流程。

地位

Rivora 正在积极开发中。

当前版本是 v0.12.0 — 引导连接器载入（收集前连接；安全凭证存储）。

请参阅连接器指南、工作区指南和 RFC-031。
